parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

AI for Quantitative & Qualitative Research led by Hadi Fariborzi (Bissett School of Business, Mount Royal University, Calgary) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar on AI for quantitative and qualitative research includes dedicated sessions on Structural Equation Modeling (SEM), directly applicable to users of the lavaan R package. Participants will learn to leverage AI as a coding and interpretation partner, enhancing their ability to specify latent constructs, interpret path coefficients, and troubleshoot models within lavaan workflows. These practical skills will enable researchers to accelerate their SEM projects, improve methodological rigor, and produce more transparent and reproducible analyses for their own studies.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
